lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Reward: Tetra Massage Voucher ×2

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: We've received your video.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text:
Please wait for a moment.
We're checking the content.
Momentary silence.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I'm sorry. We can't use this.
Why not?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: The battle went too well,

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: and they won. Ugh.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: We should have told you this before, but...

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I want a video where Nikkes lay down their lives.
Sorry, come again?

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: I told you that many people in the Ark feel sorry for Nikkes.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: They won't feel sorry if Nikkes don't lose their lives,

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: and it is only if Nikkes have fallen to their demise miserably.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Please make sure you capture some death scenes next time.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: It'd be nice to interview the Nikke before she meets her end.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Please inform me when you have a dying Nikke so we can prepare for the interview.

lines.speaker: tetraconnect
lines.text: Until next time, then.
